correctness_fix.zero_favorable_move_time_to_extreme: None when the clamped excursion is 0 (no positive favorable or adverse move inside the window); empty windows return excursions 0.0 and times None

scope_b_tp_post_factor_candidates.name: TP_POST_FACTOR
scope_b_tp_post_factor_candidates.definition: frozen v0.3.3 funnel: 4H macro aligned, 1H trend regime, 15m trend-pullback pattern, frozen factor gates with no blocked reason

e_retrace_arm.name: E-RETRACE
e_retrace_arm.candidate_generation: completely frozen v0.3.3 decision replay; a candidate must appear at its original final confirmation bar; no cooldown deduplication and no position-state censoring so the funnel reproduces the frozen 139
e_retrace_arm.limit_price: historical pullback local extreme from the last five 15m bars (min low for LONG, max high for SHORT), fully known at candidate time

causal_fill_rule.eligibility_start: first 1m bar with open_time_ms strictly after the candidate decision close

ttl.rule: expires_at_ms = decision close + min(ttl_minutes * 60000, max_signal_age_bars * 900000); extension forbidden

pending_invalidation.evaluated_on: each closed 15m decision boundary and each arriving 1m bar for expiry
pending_invalidation.note: the frozen runtime does not cancel pending signals merely because a later regime or macro label changes, so v0.3.4 does not invent that rule
pending_invalidation.rr_recheck: deferred to fill time; the runtime's continuous RR-vs-current-close recheck assumes the entry sits near the current price, which does not apply to a retrace limit whose RR is validated prospectively at the limit price and re-confirmed at fill

same_1m_ambiguity.entry_and_stop: stop-first: LOSS at the stop price
same_1m_ambiguity.entry_and_target: fill-then-resolve with stop priority: WIN at the target price only when the stop is not touched on the same bar (the project's existing conservative ordering)

frozen_execution.stop: original TP invalidation level with the 0.25 ATR buffer (unchanged)
frozen_execution.costs: taker fee 0.0005 per side, slippage 2 bps per side, funding stress 0.0005 x 2 events for planning, actual funding settlements applied as point-in-time cashflow

position_policy.note: each of the 139 candidates is tracked as an independent sub-position with fixed frozen-equity sizing; the runtime max_open_positions=1 policy would censor the candidate funnel and is deliberately not applied; concurrent-open counts are reported
position_policy.note_cooldown: candidate events are counted exactly as the frozen v0.3.3 funnel with no fingerprint cooldown between orders

risk_plan.prospective: at signal creation: stop, target, gross/net RR, and notional computed from the limit price with the frozen cost model
risk_plan.at_fill: re-confirm net RR >= 1.8, notional >= minimum, not expired, not invalidated; only compliant fills open trades
risk_plan.rr_failed_at_fill_note: under frozen geometry the at-fill recheck must reproduce the prospective plan because the fill price equals the limit price; any occurrence indicates an implementation error

right_censoring.PENDING_AT_END: orders still pending at development end; excluded from resolved statistics but kept in fill-rate denominators
right_censoring.OPEN_AT_END: trades still open at development end; excluded from performance metrics

matched_controls.purpose: isolate the incremental directional information of TP post-factor candidates beyond merely being in a trend regime
matched_controls.pool: all 15m trend-regime decision bars (TREND_UP / TREND_DOWN) in the development window, excluding the 404 TP pattern candidate bars

matching.direction: TREND_UP maps to LONG, TREND_DOWN maps to SHORT; must equal the candidate direction
matching.same_1h_regime_note: by construction of the direction rule; candidate directions only occur in their aligned trend regime
matching.volatility: same 15m ATR-percentile decile, decile = min(9, floor(atr_percentile * 10))
matching.selection: deterministic: the K eligible controls with the smallest absolute 15m bar distance from the candidate, ties broken by the earlier decision close
matching.sharing: a control point may be matched to more than one candidate
matching.coverage: recorded when fewer than K eligible controls exist

directionality.reference: decision close of the candidate or control bar
directionality.signed_return: LONG: (future_close - reference) / ATR; SHORT: (reference - future_close) / ATR; future_close is the close of the last 1m bar inside the horizon window
directionality.mfe_mae: nonnegative semantics as defined in correctness_fix
directionality.incomplete_rule: windows truncated at development_end_exclusive (or empty) are marked incomplete and excluded from that horizon's statistics

statistics.delta_definition: per horizon and metric: median(candidates) - median(pooled matched controls); reach deltas are rate differences
statistics.bootstrap: candidate-level cluster-aware: resample candidates with replacement, each carrying its matched controls; one resample per simulation shared by all metrics
statistics.leave_one_year_out: reported for the 4h and 8h signed-return deltas

H9_directional_edge.statement: TP post-factor candidates contain incremental directional information beyond merely being in a trend regime
H9_directional_edge.gate: at least 30 candidates with complete 4h labels and mean matched controls per candidate >= 3.0, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_SAMPLE
H9_directional_edge.support_rule: all of: 4h and 8h signed-return deltas > 0; bootstrap p05 of the 4h and 8h deltas >= -0.05 ATR; +1 ATR reach delta > 0 at both 4h and 8h; +2.5 ATR reach delta > 0 at 4h or 8h; leave-one-year-out 4h and 8h deltas remain positive for every excluded year
H9_directional_edge.falsification_rule: both 4h and 8h signed-return deltas <= 0, or bootstrap p95 <= 0 for both the 4h and 8h deltas
H9_directional_edge.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE_MECHANISM (e.g. positive point estimates with confidence intervals too wide)

H10_causal_retrace_entry.statement: after confirmation, a causal retrace limit to the known pullback extreme converts late-entry geometry into executable RR-compliant trades

verdict_rules.supported: valid_fills >= 20 AND filled / limit_placed >= 0.30 AND opened / filled >= 0.50
verdict_rules.falsified_when_evaluable: valid_fills >= 20 while any supported condition fails
verdict_rules.below_10_falsified_if: prospective_rr_pass_count < 10 (even a perfect fill rate could not produce 10 RR-compliant trades)
verdict_rules.below_10_inconclusive_mechanism_if: prospective_rr_pass_count >= 10 but valid_fills < 10 (execution too rare to evaluate)

H10_causal_retrace_entry.static_diagnostic_not_a_fill: the v0.3.3 static 18/139 supplementary diagnostic is never counted as a fill

candidate_gate.rule: RECOMMEND_FOR_V0.3.5_CANDIDATE_RESEARCH iff H10 is SUPPORTED and H9 is not FALSIFIED; otherwise NO_CANDIDATE
candidate_gate.note: even a profitable development result cannot freeze a candidate in v0.3.4; an independent v0.3.5 review decides
